name: Cathedral Interior
desc: Gothic nave in one-point perspective — columns and pointed arches receding to a glowing rose window that slowly rotates, lancet windows twinkling below, rib-vault ceiling lines, checkered tiles, colored light pools drifting across the floor, rows of flickering candles down both aisles, and dust motes hanging in the light. Styles: stone gothic, golden hour, overgrown ruin, neon chapel, ice chapel.
